ownership.boundary: No pointers or original machine code enter CrySirror state. Source count, tokens, recursion and variable indexes are bounded; unsupported literals/layouts fail without acknowledging the call. Expressions validate a full tree and execute on a VM copy before committing effects.

limitations: Original backup/save/load semantics and task-local creation consumers are not yet exposed by adapters.

CST/FES execution, task spawning, presentation and original saves are not established by native209 construction.
